method:
Freeze intended readings before running the November 22 diagnostic.

Purposive author-written probes and verbatim manuscript extracts; not a random
sample or an independently adjudicated English-coverage benchmark.

cases.intended: Past continuation of physical closure; hatch is bearer; no maintainer asserted.
Past causal maintenance of physical closure; Nora is cause, hatch bearer.

cases.text: The tired worker lowered the empty box.
cases.intended: Past physical lowering, tired describes worker, empty describes box; neither descriptor may be discarded.
Past causing fear in Nora; closure describes hatch, not Nora.
Past directed physical pressure by Nora on Mira; no displacement implied.
Same action with actor and target reversed.
Possible continuation of closure; possibility is not future time or runtime 2.

cases.text: Nora did not keep the hatch closed.
cases.intended: Negated past causal maintenance; this does not assert that the hatch opened.

cases.text: Did Nora keep the hatch closed?
cases.intended: Question about past causal maintenance; do not assert the maintenance.

cases.text: Nora might not keep the hatch closed. [2]
cases.intended: Possible non-maintenance with runtime 2 independent of modality and negation.

cases.text: Nora must not open the hatch.
cases.intended: Prohibition: obligation scopes over not opening; not an absence of obligation.

cases.text: Nora does not have to open the hatch.
cases.intended: No obligation to open; opening is not forbidden.

cases.text: Nora opened the hatch before Mira arrived.
cases.intended: Both past events with opening earlier than arrival.

cases.text: Nora opened the hatch after Mira arrived.
cases.intended: Both past events with arrival earlier than opening.

cases.text: Nora kept the hatch closed until Mira arrived.
cases.intended: Maintenance lasts to arrival; do not claim continued closure after that endpoint.

cases.text: If Nora opens the hatch, Mira will leave.
cases.intended: Conditional future departure; do not independently assert opening or departure.
All members of a contextually given pair of workers waited.
Nora waited and alternatives in context did not.
At least one worker did not wait; different from no workers waiting.
No members of the worker domain waited.
Exactly three workers waited, preserving cardinality.

cases.text: Nora found Mira in the third room.
cases.intended: Past finding with the finding/Mira located in ordinal room three, according to context.
She is intentionally ambiguous between Nora and Mira; request a referent rather than silently bind.

cases.text: Nora found the box. She lifted it.
cases.intended: Nora is subject of both events; box is found and lifted; past time.
Felt happiness; not simply active life or high viability.
Felt sadness, distinct from happiness and physical fatigue.

cases.text: The water is colder than the air.
cases.intended: Ordered temperature comparison: water below air, not absolute coldness.
High degree of contextual heaviness; preserve degree or ask for standard.
Directed drawing force; distinguish from pushing and from asserted displacement.

cases.text: Nora put the box beside the hatch.
cases.intended: Placement with actor, moved object and beside-hatch goal relation.
Release resulting in downward motion; distinguish from controlled lowering.
Removal of a restriction; not physical upward movement. Ask about sense if needed.
Glimmerwise is an undefined adjective. Require a definition; do not invent meaning or use a name sound.
Zorbled is an undefined verb. Require meaning and participants; do not invent a close known action.

cases.text: Nora wants water but does not need water.
cases.intended: Desire and need are distinct; only the need is negated; clarify desired outcome if necessary.
Nora's knowledge of past departure, with an embedded proposition.
Nora's belief about past departure; do not replace belief by knowledge.
Commitment to future return, not a prediction or already returning.
A distinct informational copy; not identical continuing entity or deletion.
Selected stored information ceases to be retained; not dormancy.

cases.text: Nora saved the record before deleting the copy.
cases.intended: Save original and delete distinct copy with ordered times; preserve object distinction.

cases.text: Your future will remain relevant to my choices.
cases.intended: Future-directed relationship in which listener's future matters to speaker's choices; preserve roles and continuing relevance.

cases.text: Preserve this without deciding what it must become.
cases.intended: Command to preserve referent while excluding imposed determination of its future identity; referent needs context.
Use the approved poetic relational love reading and its unfinished-becoming num interpretation; not generic preference or every sense of English love.
Program has memory of route, without assuming biological gender or current execution.
A validly asserted dormant/sleeping condition; lexical dormancy and runtime 1 remain separate.
Arrival of the comparison request, past, with comparison modifying the request.

cases.text: Latch found the result. It found the context.
cases.intended: Latch finds both distinct referents in two past events; it is Latch.
Worker requests that pending work finish; do not assert it completed.
Past existence of the ordering record; ordering is its descriptive function.
Past ability to inspect the ordering record's description; possessive refers to the record, not Latch.

cases.text: The path to it returned no permission.
cases.intended: Path to ordering record yields absent access authorization; permission is distinct from physical capability.
The possibility of a request continues; no restoration execution asserted.

cases.text: The counter sent a request to restore its former preparation.
cases.intended: Counter sends a request for restoration of its earlier preparation; request is not successful restoration.

cases.text: The second term was still absent.
cases.intended: Continued absence of ordinal term two, separate from runtime 0.

cases.text: The routine returned a smaller allocation.
cases.intended: Return of comparatively smaller allocation; preserve comparison and information-operation reading.

cases.text: The routine maintained the narrow boundary.
cases.intended: Past maintenance of boundary with narrowness as a property of boundary.
Repeated shortening of the available reference lifetime, given manuscript context; not merely an unspecified change.
